$comment: Starter packs for proactive agents (Claude Duet, OpenAI Dots): three or four Duet-ready skills per person, because an always-on agent works best with a few skills that match the work, not dozens. Every skill must be in data/duet-ready.json (tests/checks/duet-packs.mjs).

packs.title: Founder
packs.for: Running a small company: you want a morning picture and early warnings, not more email.

packs.title: Freelancer
packs.for: Clients, invoices and follow-ups across one inbox, with nothing sent to a client without you.

packs.title: Shop owner
packs.for: An online shop: stock, refunds, reviews and cash, with interruptions only when money is at stake.

packs.title: Team lead
packs.for: A shared agent and honest reporting: what shipped, what is waiting, and the weekly picture for your manager.

packs.title: Business operations
packs.for: The back office: payroll, contracts awaiting signature and cash, under a clear approval policy.
